current_affairs.title: Supreme Court Clarifies Scope of Article 142 Inherent Powers
current_affairs.summary: The Supreme Court reaffirmed that extraordinary powers granted under Article 142 to do 'complete justice' must be used judiciously and cannot override explicit statutory provisions of existing laws.
current_affairs.upsc_relevance: GS Paper II - Structure, Organization, and Functioning of the Judiciary; Constitutional Provisions.

current_affairs.title: India Expands Conservation Efforts with Addition of New Ramsar Sites
current_affairs.summary: India designated new wetland ecosystems under the Ramsar Convention, strengthening international recognition for vulnerable aquatic biodiversity and migratory bird habitats across key states.
current_affairs.upsc_relevance: GS Paper III - Conservation, Environmental Pollution and Degradation, Environmental Impact Assessment.

current_affairs.title: RBI Tests Offline Capabilities for Digital Rupee (CBDC)
current_affairs.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has initiated pilot testing for offline transactions using the Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC-P), aiming to bolster financial inclusion in regions with low connectivity.
current_affairs.upsc_relevance: GS Paper III - Indian Economy, Monetary Policy, Digital Public Infrastructure, and Banking Sector Reforms.

current_affairs.title: ISRO Advances Gaganyaan Mission with Successful Propulsion Motor Tests
current_affairs.summary: ISRO completed key static testing of the high-altitude motor for the Gaganyaan Crew Escape System, marking a crucial step toward India's inaugural human spaceflight mission.
current_affairs.upsc_relevance: GS Paper III - Awareness in the fields of Space, Technology Transfer, and Achievements of Indians in Science.

current_affairs.title: India Signs 10-Year Long-Term Contract for Chabahar Port Operations
current_affairs.summary: India Ports Global Limited executed a landmark agreement with Iran to operate the Shahid Beheshti Terminal at Chabahar Port, facilitating direct trade corridors to Central Asia and bypassing traditional maritime bottlenecks.
current_affairs.upsc_relevance: GS Paper II - India and its Neighborhood-Relations, Bilateral Agreements, and Strategic Connectivity Projects.
